tagline_zh: 让企业到岗、居民日常和轨道换乘共享一条可回退的活动链
tagline_en: One reversible activity chain for enterprise arrival, daily life and rail transfer

logo_contract.mark: three connected nodes around an open loop
logo_contract.meaning_zh: 企业、居民、轨道三类入口共用一条保持人工出口的活动链
logo_contract.meaning_en: Enterprise, resident and rail entrances share an activity chain that keeps a human exit

public_experience_nodes.name_zh: 众智园 · 企业交通台
public_experience_nodes.role_zh: 看懂分组通勤与路缘状态
public_experience_nodes.role_en: Read grouped commuting and curb status
public_experience_nodes.experience_zh: 公开看板、电话和纸面入口；不展示员工个人轨迹
public_experience_nodes.experience_en: Public board, phone and paper access; no employee trajectories

public_experience_nodes.name_zh: AI 原点社区 · 人工服务台
public_experience_nodes.name_en: AI Origin community · human access desk
public_experience_nodes.role_zh: 用同一条日常路线比较 AI、人工、电话和纸面入口
public_experience_nodes.role_en: Compare AI, human, telephone and paper access on the same daily route
public_experience_nodes.experience_zh: 居民可以不注册、不使用 App，直接提出需求和异议
public_experience_nodes.experience_en: Residents can raise a request or objection without registration or an app

public_experience_nodes.name_zh: 大钟寺 · 轨道换乘展台
public_experience_nodes.role_zh: 看见地铁、公交、骑行、步行与无障碍如何交接
public_experience_nodes.role_en: See how metro, bus, bicycle, walking and accessible routes connect
public_experience_nodes.experience_zh: 展示五种路缘状态和停止条件，不展示未授权的航线或绩效
public_experience_nodes.experience_en: Show five curb states and stop conditions, not an unauthorised air route or performance

pilgrimage_contract.sequence_zh: 观察企业问题 → 体验居民入口 → 复核轨道与路缘
pilgrimage_contract.sequence_en: Observe enterprise needs → use the resident entry → review rail and curb
pilgrimage_contract.purpose_zh: 把 AI 朝圣理解成公开学习和复核路线，不把它写成已建成景点或活动品牌
pilgrimage_contract.purpose_en: Treat AI pilgrimage as a public learning and review route, not a built attraction or event brand

boundary: This brand system is a proposed public-facing identity and experience contract. It does not establish a logo approval, venue, event, partner, tourism result, permit or deployment.
